title: FAMILY PRAYER
JOSHUA 24:15
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: ancient chapel interior candlelight peaceful sanctuary
divine light breaking through clouds over peaceful landscape
peaceful mountain river calm water forest
sunlight breaking through clouds mountain pass
golden light rays through clouds over mountain peak

scenes.a: Gather your home and loved ones in faith around the unchanging Word of God today.
Joshua twenty-four verse fifteen declares, But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
A praying household is never left unroofed; God's covenant mercy shelters every room.
Father, we consecrate our marriage, our children, and every threshold unto Jesus Christ.
Fill our conversations with kindness, heal every strain, and rule our home with Your peace.
Bless the work of our hands, supply every need, and guard our going out and coming in.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Family Altar to cover your home in daily prayer.
